TS0250001.message: No Pipeline draft with id '{id}' exists.
TS0250001.solution: Create the draft or list Pipeline drafts to find an existing id.

TS0250002.message: A Pipeline draft with id '{id}' already exists.
TS0250002.solution: Choose a different Pipeline id, or edit the existing draft.

TS0250003.message: Pipeline draft '{id}' requires its current revision for this operation.
TS0250003.solution: Read the draft, then retry with its revision in If-Match.

TS0250004.message: Pipeline draft '{id}' changed after it was read.
TS0250004.solution: Read the current draft and retry with its new revision.

TS0250005.solution: Fix the draft at the reported location, then preview or publish it again.

TS0250006.message: Pipeline draft '{id}' cannot change authoring mode after creation.
TS0250006.solution: Keep the existing draft mode, or create a new draft with the desired mode.

TS0250007.message: Pipeline draft '{id}' is based on an artifact that changed after it was read.
TS0250007.solution: Read the current Pipeline and draft, then retry the publish operation.
